Thanks for the heads-up, Nina — Wed 9/22 10:00am–10:45am PST works on our side.

Quick answers for procurement/security:
- Recording: yes — we can record the session for internal review. We’ll include the recording in a private link and mark retention to 30 days by default; if you need a different retention window we can note that in the follow-up.
- Logs & retention: Redwood stores inference logs (non-PII request/response metadata) for up to 30 days by default in hosted mode; Dedicated/Private deployments can be configured to meet longer retention or zero retention policies — we can detail options in the follow-up.

Soojin — can you come prepared to show a 10-minute demo of a typical inference flow (prefix caching + batching) and a 10-minute deep-dive on profiling/latency tradeoffs? Priyom — can you prepare a brief slide on pilot milestones (SOW → pilot → scale) and a sample timeline (4–6 weeks)?

I’ll send an updated calendar invite with attachments and a DocuSign link for a simple pilot engagement checklist (no signature required, just to capture scope).

See you Wed — invite forthcoming.

Best,
Karthik
